**Finding: compliant** — no redline proposed.

The document's IP architecture satisfies the preferred position on every material term:

- **§ 14.1** — Customer owns Customer Data, Customer Confidential Information, Customer-provided material and independently developed IP; Vendor gets only a limited processing right to deliver/secure/support the Services. Reinforced by **§ 15.1** (no sale, no advertising use, no commingling, no model training without consent).
- **§ 14.2** — Customer owns each Deliverable on creation, with a present assignment from Vendor, flow-down assignments from Vendor personnel, and further-assurance. (Payment condition is standard and acceptable.)
- **§ 14.3** — Vendor retains only Vendor Technology, and embedded Vendor Technology is licensed under § 13.2; Vendor must pre-identify material Vendor Technology and cannot embed restrictive third-party material without approval.
- **§ 13.2** — Licence-back is perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, fully paid, covers Affiliates and contractors, and includes modify/derivative-works rights (§ 13.3 adds transferability to Affiliates/successors).
- **§ 14.4** — No joint ownership absent a signed instrument; feedback is voluntary and Customer retains unrestricted rights in its own feedback.

No assignment of our IP or data to Copperleaf and no joint-ownership exposure, so nothing to redline here.
